text:
Hannah Cole: Quick idea  run a tiny PLG experiment around Prompt Templates + webinar. Two arms: RSVP-claim 40 credits vs instant 160 credits. Deliverables: landing, 3 social posts, webinar ops, routing + CRM tag, and onboarding nudge A/B. Keep it 10 days.

Marco Ruiz: Sounds good. Metrics: signup -> template_used (7d), token velocity, and 14d retention. Recommend 700-1k per arm.

Lena Ortiz: I'll draft social and email. Social cadence: teaser (2d before), playbook highlight (1d), CTA (morning of). Email subject ideas: "New Prompt Templates: ship faster" and "Claim webinar credits + live demo".

Samir Khan: Routing plan: annotate signup links with ?exp=tpl_rsvp or tpl_open, push to CRM, and route hot leads (token>threshold) to AE. Pseudo: 

```
const exp = req.query.exp || 'tpl_open';
crm.tag(userId, `exp:${exp}`);
if (exp === 'tpl_rsvp') routeTo('ae_queue', 'high');
else routeTo('growth_inbound', 'normal');
```

EngBot: Registered experiment id=exp_tpl_may2024. Dashboard stub: https://growth.internal/exp/exp_tpl_may2024. Budget cap: 200k tokens/arm.

Hannah Cole: Assigning owners: Lena - copy + social + slides; Marco - metrics & dashboard; Samir - routing + Zap; I'll own comms and benchmark one-pager. Launch target Mon 2024-05-13. Can everyone confirm?

Marco Ruiz: Confirmed. I'll create a day3/day7/day10 snapshot and a quick look ML eval for template reuse.

Lena Ortiz: Drafts up by Thu EOD. In-app nudge variants: A) short: "Try a Prompt Template  2 min to ship. [Open templates]" B) guided: "Want a quick win? Try 'Cold Outreach' template with tips. [Start guide]"

Samir Khan: Will push routing to staging and add tests. Also will wire exp param into CRM lead view.

Hannah Cole: Perfect  add links to docs when ready and we'll review numbers in Friday's sync. :rocket:
